I'll combine this with the gradient color using another `mix` operation, scaling the noise factor to 0.015.

This is where the real detail work comes in. The entire typographic layout is anchored to a strict 0.25-unit baseline grid and left-aligned at `x = -3.1`. This means I need to meticulously position each text element. I'll be leveraging `ctx.fontAtlas.createText` for generating the text geometry and textures. *   **Body Paragraph:** "Notes from the bench..." – this has a `maxWidth` of 4.5 units. I'll use `fontSize: 26` and set the `maxWidthPx` option accordingly in `createText`. It sits at `y = -0.8`.

The spec calls for a letterpress shadow for the hero text by duplicating the glyph planes and offsetting them 0.02 units behind with the ink color (`#16161d`). import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, fract, sin, dot, float } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  // Root container
  const container = new Group();

  // Create local timelines to track
  const activeTimelines = [];

  // Define colors from spec
  const colorBgHex = '#0b0b10';
  const colorSurfaceHex = '#14141a';
  const colorInkHex = '#16161d';
  const colorPaperHex = '#e8ecf2';
  const colorAccentHex = '#ff2a38';

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 1. Stage / Background Plate with Engineered Gradient & Grain
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  const bgGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 5.5);
  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();

  const uvY = uv().y;
  const colBottom = vec3(new Color(colorBgHex));
  const colTop = vec3(new Color(colorSurfaceHex));
  const gradColor = mix(colBottom, colTop, uvY);

  // 1.5% monochrome grain TSL logic
  const pseudoNoise = fract(sin(dot(uv().xy, vec3(12.9898, 78.233, 37.719).xy)) * float(43758.5453));
  const finalBgColor = mix(gradColor, vec3(pseudoNoise), float(0.015));
  bgMat.colorNode = finalBgColor;

  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeo, bgMat);
  bgMesh.position.set(0, 0, -0.05);
  container.add(bgMesh);

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Add Typography Elements
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  const textGroup = new Group();
  container.add(textGroup);

  // A. Kicker
  const kicker = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("NOVA ATELIER / JOURNAL", {
    fontSize: 20,
    color: colorPaperHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: 3
  });
  kicker.position.set(-3.1, 1.7, 0.01);
  kicker.userData = { targetY: 1.7 };
  textGroup.add(kicker);

  // B. Hero Line 1 (with Shadow)
  const h1Shadow = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("PRECISION IS", {
    fontSize: 68,
    color: colorInkHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: -1
  });
  h1Shadow.position.set(-3.1, 0.9, 0.01);
  h1Shadow.userData = { targetY: 0.9 };
  textGroup.add(h1Shadow);

  const h1 = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("PRECISION IS", {
    fontSize: 68,
    color: colorPaperHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: -1
  });
  h1.position.set(-3.1, 0.9, 0.03);
  h1.userData = { targetY: 0.9 };
  textGroup.add(h1);

  // C. Hero Line 2 (with Shadow)
  const h2Shadow = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("A HABIT.", {
    fontSize: 68,
    color: colorInkHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: -1
  });
  h2Shadow.position.set(-3.1, 0.25, 0.01);
  h2Shadow.userData = { targetY: 0.25 };
  textGroup.add(h2Shadow);

  const h2 = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("A HABIT.", {
    fontSize: 68,
    color: colorPaperHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: -1
  });
  h2.position.set(-3.1, 0.25, 0.03);
  h2.userData = { targetY: 0.25 };
  textGroup.add(h2);

  // D. Accent Underline Rule
  // We use a hierarchical pivot group so we can scaleX 0 -> 1 starting from x=-3.1 left boundary
  const underlinePivot = new Group();
  underlinePivot.position.set(-3.1, -0.15, 0.02);

  const ruleMeshGeo = new PlaneGeometry(2.2, 0.05);
  const ruleMeshMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  ruleMeshMat.colorNode = vec3(new Color(colorAccentHex));

  const ruleMesh = new Mesh(ruleMeshGeo, ruleMeshMat);
  ruleMesh.position.set(1.1, 0, 0); // Offset to maintain left anchor point
  underlinePivot.add(ruleMesh);
  textGroup.add(underlinePivot);

  // E. Body Paragraph
  const body = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("Notes from the bench: tolerances, tempering, and the case for slower watchmaking.", {
    fontSize: 24,
    color: colorPaperHex,
    align: 'left',
    maxWidthPx: 800
  });
  body.position.set(-3.1, -0.8, 0.01);
  body.userData = { targetY: -0.8 };
  textGroup.add(body);

  // F. Caption
  const caption = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("ISSUE 12 / JULY 2026", {
    fontSize: 18,
    color: colorPaperHex,
    align: 'left',
    letterSpacingPx: 2
  });
  caption.position.set(-3.1, -1.9, 0.01);
  caption.userData = { targetY: -1.9 };
  textGroup.add(caption);

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 3. Entrance Animation Sequence
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // Setup initial states
  const animatableBlocks = [
    { target: kicker },
    { target: h1 },
    { target: h1Shadow },
    { target: h2 },
    { target: h2Shadow },
    { target: body },
    { target: caption }
  ];

  animatableBlocks.forEach(block => {
    block.target.position.y = block.target.userData.targetY - 0.4;
    block.target.scale.set(0.001, 0.001, 1);
  });

  underlinePivot.scale.x = 0;

  // Master entrance timeline
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  activeTimelines.push(tl);

  // Stagger animate blocks
  animatableBlocks.forEach((block, index) => {
    tl.to(block.target.position, {
      y: block.target.userData.targetY,
      duration: 0.7,
      ease: 'cubic.out'
    }, index * 0.08);

    tl.to(block.target.scale, {
      x: 1,
      y: 1,
      duration: 0.6,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    }, index * 0.08);
  });

  // Scale in the accent underline after the hero sections settle
  tl.to(underlinePivot.scale, {
    x: 1,
    duration: 0.5,
    ease: 'sine.out'
  }, 0.4);

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 4. Lifecycle Cleanups
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  container.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      activeTimelines.forEach(t => t.kill());
      bgGeo.dispose();
      bgMat.dispose();
      ruleMeshGeo.dispose();
      ruleMeshMat.dispose();
      // Font geometries are managed via the internally instantiated nodes from fontAtlas
    }
  };

  return container;
}
